newsitem.title: UK: Cheltenham&Gloucester ups UK mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Cheltenham&Gloucester ups UK mortgage rate.

text.p: Cheltenham & Gloucester Building Society, the UK's fourth largest mortgage lender, on Tuesday said it was raising its variable mortgage base rate to 7.6 percent from 7.22 percent.
The new rate is effective from May 12 for new applicants and from June 1 for established borrowers.
Cheltenham & Gloucester is part of Lloyds TSB Group Plc following Lloyds Bank's merger with TSB and Cheltenham & Gloucester in 1995.
The UK's 11th largest building society, the Coventry, said it was raising its basic mortgage rate by 35 basis points to 7.60 percent from June 1.
